en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a distant panoramic view of a town built on the slope of a hill, with many small houses clustered together. In the foreground there is a straight tree-lined road or path leading toward the town. The lower margin contains printed captions in Greek and French identifying the place as Levadia in Greece and the view as the city entrance. There are two Greek postage stamps affixed at the upper-right corner and a faint postmark. The website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears across the image.
